summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Interest Income module. All 18 backend API tests passed (100%). All 10 frontend UI tests passed (100%). Full CRUD operations working. Auto-calculation and manual override features functioning correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Auto-calculation formula correctly implements: Simple Interest = Principal * Rate / 100 / FrequencyDivisor
Compound Interest formula correctly implements compounding periods calculation
Manual Override toggle properly switches between auto-calculated and user input modes
Compounding Frequency dropdown correctly shows/hides based on Interest Type selection
All date fields appear dynamically based on Income Frequency selection (Monthly, Quarterly, Half-Yearly, Yearly, Others)
Interest-specific fields (principal, rate, interestType, compoundingFrequency, manualOverride) properly persisted in API
All data-testid attributes properly implemented for testing
Console warnings about hydration errors (span inside select) are React development warnings, not critical issues
seed_data_creation: Test data created and cleaned up automatically (UI_TEST_* prefixed entries)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Interest Income module fully functional. Backend API at /api/income supports full CRUD with type='Interest' filtering. Frontend routes: / (Income Type) → /my-interest (Interest List) → /interest-income (Create/Edit). Interest-specific fields: principal, rate, interestType, compoundingFrequency, manualOverride. Auto-calculation works based on P*R/100/FrequencyDivisor. Manual Override allows user to input custom expected income.
